name: sync-cakrawala
description: SYNC Cakrawala — multi-division operational coordination platform

scripts.dev: concurrently -n api,web -c blue,green "npm run dev -w @sync/api" "npm run dev -w @sync/web"
scripts.build: npm run build -w @sync/api && npm run build -w @sync/web
scripts.lint: npm run lint -w @sync/api --if-present && npm run lint -w @sync/web --if-present
